verdict.en: A fire-zone tool for blocking corridors and chipping big ARC, not a way to get kills quickly.
verdict.zh: 封路与消耗大型ARC的火区工具，不适合快速击杀。

use.en: The fire burns for 10 seconds in a wide area, so throw it into a hallway or stair while you heal, loot or retreat. Players can simply walk out, so expect to herd them, not kill them. Against Bastions and Bombardiers it stacks as steady chip damage; community trial guides use 5 or 6 on a Bombardier. The trap version only adds a tripwire.
use.zh: 火焰在大范围内持续10秒，适合在你回血、搜刮或撤退时封住走廊或楼梯。玩家走出去就行，所以它是逼人改路线而不是杀人。对“堡垒”和“投弹手”是稳定的持续伤害，社区的试炼攻略会用5到6颗打一只“投弹手”。陷阱版只是多了绊线触发。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Explosives Station level 3 once you have the blueprint, or buy it from Apollo (limit 3). The quests What Goes Around and Test Case also hand out 3 each. Oil is the main input, so keep some in stock.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在爆炸物工作台3级制作，也可向阿波罗购买（限购3个）。任务“因果报应”和“测试案例”各奖励3个。主要材料是油，记得备着。

tips.en: Recycling returns Metal Parts and Oil, so spares are not wasted.
tips.zh: 回收能得到金属零件和油，多余的不亏。

tips.en: The trap needs only a Wires on top of a grenade; make it only if you like ambush setups.
tips.zh: 陷阱只需在手雷上加一个导线；喜欢设伏再做。

verdict.en: The only mine that really hurts, worth two or three in a PvP loadout, but it will not kill a healthy Raider alone.
verdict.zh: 唯一真正能造成伤害的地雷，PvP配装带两三个值得，但单靠它杀不死满血玩家。

use.en: It pops up and blows after a 1 second delay, so place it where people must pass: behind a door, near loot, in grass or around a corner. Its damage swings a fight by putting the target behind, and the bang tells you where they are. Do not set it in a contested spot you will walk through yourself; a clip going around shows a camper's mine killing him and his killer.
use.zh: 它弹起后延迟1秒爆炸，要放在必经之路：门后、战利品旁、草丛或拐角。伤害足以让对手处于劣势，爆炸声还会暴露他的位置。别布在自己也要经过的争夺点；有视频里蹲点者的地雷把他和击杀他的人一起炸死了。

obtain.en: No trader sells it. Craft it at the Explosives Station level 3 after learning the blueprint, scavenge one, or take the Building a Library quest reward. The AR/RD 001 Ryder & Voyager Raider Deck also lists it.
obtain.zh: 商人不卖。学会蓝图后在爆炸物工作台3级制作，也可搜刮或领取“丰富图书室”的任务奖励。猎人卡组 AR/RD 001 中也有。

tips.en: Keep one for Building a Library; recycling gives only Oil and Sensors.
tips.zh: 留一个给“丰富图书室”；回收只有油和传感器。

tips.en: Check before you walk back through your own placement.
tips.zh: 回头经过自己布雷的位置前先确认。

verdict.en: A harmless noisemaker, only worth holding for the Combat Recon and The League quests.
verdict.zh: 只会发声发光的小玩意，只有“战斗侦察”和“球队”任务才值得留。

use.en: It sparks and pops for a few seconds and deals no damage. I found no source claiming it changes ARC behavior, so if you want a decoy use a Lure Grenade instead.
use.zh: 它会噼啪冒火花几秒，没有伤害。我没找到说它能影响ARC行为的来源，想要诱饵请用诱捕手雷。

obtain.en: Shani sells it, you can craft it at the Utility Station level 1, or scavenge it. Both The League and Combat Recon reward 5.
obtain.zh: 萨尼出售，也可在工具工作台1级制作或搜刮。“球队”和“战斗侦察”各奖励5个。

tips.en: Do not craft more than the quests need; recycling returns less than half the Plastic Parts it cost.
tips.zh: 别多做；回收返还的塑料零件不到成本的一半。

verdict.en: A remote-fired damage tool aimed at ARC, best against flyers, and not a replacement for real grenades.
verdict.zh: 遥控引爆、主要对付ARC（尤其飞行单位）的伤害工具，替代不了正经手雷。

use.en: Place it, back away and trigger it yourself. Guides describe steady damage to ARC rather than one big hit, strongest on flying ARC and turrets. Mounting it on a wall makes the fireworks fly sideways at a flyer. It is not meant for killing players.
use.zh: 放好后退开再自己引爆。攻略称其对ARC是持续的累积伤害而非一击重创，对飞行ARC和炮塔最好用。装在墙上能让烟花横向射向飞行单位。它不是用来杀玩家的。

obtain.en: Shani sells it for 6000 coins (limit 3). Craft it at the Explosives Station level 2 from an Explosive Compound and 3 Pop Triggers. Movie Night and Combat Recon each give one.
obtain.zh: 萨尼出售，售价6000钱币（限购3个）。可在爆炸物工作台2级用炸药混合物和3个“爆爆”触发器制作。“电影之夜”和“战斗侦察”各奖励一个。

tips.en: Do not recycle it: you only get back the Explosive Compound, losing the Pop Triggers.
tips.zh: 别回收：只返还炸药混合物，“爆爆”触发器就白费了。

verdict.en: A short-range novelty flamethrower: low damage, and every one costs a Fireball Burner you must hunt.
verdict.zh: 近距离的噱头喷火器：伤害低，而且每把都要消耗一个得去猎杀才能拿到的“火球”燃烧炉。

use.en: It sprays fire where you aim at 10 damage per second, which is modest next to any gun. Its only real appeal is close ambushes or burning a target in a tight space. I found no player write-up calling it worth a quick-use slot.
use.zh: 它朝瞄准方向喷火，每秒10点伤害，比任何枪都低。唯一的价值是近距离偷袭或在狭窄空间点燃目标。我没找到玩家说它值得占一个快捷栏。

obtain.en: It can only be crafted in a raid, from an Air Freshener and a Fireball Burner. Burners drop from Fireball ARC; the Water Treatment area on Dam Battlegrounds is a reliable place to kill one. Keeping an Eye Out also rewards one.
obtain.zh: 只能在局内用空气清新剂和“火球”燃烧炉制作。燃烧炉由“火球”掉落；大坝战场的水处理厂是比较稳的刷点。“循目追踪”任务也奖励一把。

tips.en: If you do not plan to use it, recycle it: you get the Canister and the Burner back.
tips.zh: 不打算用就回收：能拿回小罐和燃烧炉。

verdict.en: A cheap PvP disruptor that stops people running, but the tripwire trap version is widely seen as the weakest trap.
verdict.zh: 便宜的PvP干扰手雷，能让人跑不动；但绊线陷阱版被普遍认为是最弱的陷阱。

use.en: It does no health damage; it drains stamina so a Raider in the cloud cannot sprint, slide or jump. That makes it good for cutting off a fleeing player or stalling a push in a corridor. One wiki note says the cloud actually lasts about 10 seconds, not the listed 20, so time your follow-up.
use.zh: 它不造成生命伤害，而是消耗耐力，云里的玩家无法冲刺、滑铲或跳跃。适合堵截逃跑的人或在走廊拖住对方推进。有维基备注称云实际约持续10秒，而非列出的20秒，所以要抓紧追击。

obtain.en: Cheap to make: Explosives Station level 1 with Chemicals and Rubber Parts. Apollo sells it for 810 coins.
obtain.zh: 制作便宜：爆炸物工作台1级，用化学品和橡胶零件。阿波罗售价810钱币。

tips.en: Skip the trap; a thrown grenade or a plain smoke is more flexible.
tips.zh: 陷阱版可以不做；直接扔手雷或烟雾更灵活。

verdict.en: A situational defensive mine; it slows people down but never kills, so it is only for chokepoint play.
verdict.zh: 偏防守的情境地雷，只能拖慢对手而不能击杀，仅适合守点位。

use.en: It triggers when someone walks into range, then lays a stamina-draining cloud. Put it at a doorway or retreat route so pursuers lose their sprint. For kills, the Explosive Mine is the better pick.
use.zh: 有人进入范围就触发，释放消耗耐力的云。放在门口或撤退路线上，让追兵失去冲刺。想要击杀，爆炸地雷更合适。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Explosives Station level 1 once you hold the blueprint. Cold Storage and A Toxic Trail each reward 3. I found no reliable spawn spots.
obtain.zh: 拿到蓝图后在爆炸物工作台1级制作。“冷冻储藏”和“有毒的踪迹”各奖励3个。没有找到可靠的刷新点。

tips.en: Salvaging gives 2 Chemicals, more than recycling back the 1 each, if you only want Chemicals.
tips.zh: 只想要化学品的话，拆解能得2个化学品，比回收各1个更多。

verdict.en: The hardest-hitting craftable grenade, best on big ARC; the 3 second fuse makes it unreliable against players.
verdict.zh: 可制作手雷中爆发最高，适合打大型ARC；3秒引信让它对玩家不稳定。

use.en: Strong when it lands: 80 damage over a wide radius, good for Bastions, Bombardiers and trial scoring. Players have time to step out, and it can roll somewhere awkward. Pairing it with a Lure Grenade to hold a target still helps the blast land. One guide still calls it the most reliable all-purpose explosive.
use.zh: 命中时很强：范围大、80点伤害，适合“堡垒”、“投弹手”和试炼刷分。玩家有时间躲开，它也可能滚到奇怪的位置。配合诱捕手雷固定目标能提高命中。有攻略仍称它是最可靠的万能爆炸物。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Explosives Station level 3 (Canisters and an Explosive Compound), or buy from Apollo (limit 3). A First Foothold and The Clean Dream reward 3 each.
obtain.zh: 在爆炸物工作台3级用小罐和炸药混合物制作，或向阿波罗购买（限购3个）。“首个立足点”和“净梦计划”各奖励3个。

tips.en: It sells for 1600; do not burn them on small ARC.
tips.zh: 它能卖1600；别拿来打小型ARC。

verdict.en: Craft it for fighting ARC: the stun lasts almost twice as long on machines as on Raiders.
verdict.zh: 为打ARC而做：对机器的眩晕时间几乎是对玩家的两倍。

use.en: Place it ahead of the path, not at your feet, since it needs a moment to arm. It stuns for 7 seconds on ARC and 4 on Raiders, which gives you a free window to flank or shoot a large machine. Against players the 4 seconds is short, so a stun grenade or Showstopper is usually better.
use.zh: 要放在前进路径前方而不是脚下，因为需要一点时间启动。对ARC眩晕7秒、对玩家4秒，让你有空档绕后或输出大型机器。对玩家4秒偏短，通常用眩晕类手雷或“耀眼明星”更好。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Explosives Station level 2 from a Battery and Electrical Components. Taking Stock, Mixed Signals, Our Presence up There and Building a Library reward it. Apollo also sells it for 2550.
obtain.zh: 在爆炸物工作台2级用电池和电子元件制作。“清点物资”、“混合信号”、“我们在上面的据点”和“丰富图书室”任务奖励。阿波罗也有售，价格2550。

tips.en: It can be picked up again if it has not triggered, so you can reposition.
tips.zh: 未触发时可以收回重新布置。

verdict.en: The starter grenade: weak, cheap, and mainly a quest tool for Safe Passage.
verdict.zh: 入门手雷：威力弱、成本低，主要是“安全通路”的任务道具。

use.en: Thirty damage in a tiny radius will not threaten much; it is for finishing weakened targets or the Safe Passage quest, which only needs a couple of explosive kills. Replace it with a stronger grenade as soon as you can craft one.
use.zh: 小范围30点伤害构不成威胁，用来补刀或完成“安全通路”，该任务只需要几次爆炸击杀。能做出更强的手雷后就换掉。

obtain.en: Apollo hands out the free ones with Safe Passage. Otherwise craft it at the Explosives Station level 1; it is cheaper to craft than to buy at 810.
obtain.zh: 阿波罗在“安全通路”里发放免费的。否则在爆炸物工作台1级制作，比810的购买价便宜。

tips.en: Stay a few meters back; the small radius still hurts you.
tips.zh: 退开几米再扔；小范围也会炸到自己。

verdict.en: Cheap personal cover; bring a few, but it is too small to hide a squad.
verdict.zh: 便宜的个人掩护；带几个就行，但小得遮不住小队。

use.en: Use it to break a sniper's line of sight, cross open ground or loot a risky body. The cloud is small and lasts 6 seconds, so move as you throw. For revives or extraction cover you want the full Smoke Grenade.
use.zh: 用来切断狙击视线、穿越空地或搜刮危险的尸体。烟团小、只持续6秒，扔出后要立刻移动。想掩护救援或撤离，需要完整的烟雾手雷。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Utility Station level 1 or in raid. Safe Passage gives 5 and Dormant Barons 3. The AR/RD 001 deck's Ninja Pack also lists some.
obtain.zh: 在工具工作台1级或局内制作。“安全通路”给5个，“休眠的男爵”给3个。AR/RD 001 卡组的忍者包中也有。

tips.en: Recycling returns just 1 Chemicals of the 5 spent, so craft only what you use.
tips.zh: 回收只返还5个化学品中的1个，按需制作。

verdict.en: A good PvE tool for pulling ARC aggro, useless against players, and results are not guaranteed.
verdict.zh: 拉ARC仇恨的PvE好工具，对玩家无效，效果也不保证。

use.en: It sticks to surfaces and makes noise within a very large radius for 15 seconds. Use it to draw fire while you reposition, revive, loot, or to hold a big ARC still for a Heavy Fuze. It does not stick to Raiders, and one guide notes ARC sometimes ignores it. The trap version is rated lower than the plain grenade; it only suits ambush setups.
use.zh: 它能粘在表面上，在极大范围内持续发声15秒。用来在你转移、救援、搜刮时吸引火力，或固定大型ARC配合重型引信手雷。它不会粘在玩家身上，也有攻略提到ARC有时会无视它。陷阱版评价低于普通手雷，只适合设伏。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Utility Station level 2 after learning the blueprint (Speaker Component and Electrical Components). It is needed by many quests: Boarding the Frigate, Tracks of the Beast, Clamoring for Attention, Stable Housing, On Deaf Ears.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工具工作台2级用扬声器零件和电子元件制作。许多任务需要：“登上护卫者”、“巨兽踪迹”、“哗众取宠”、“稳固住宅”、“充耳不闻”。

tips.en: Keep several for quests before using them freely.
tips.zh: 先给任务留够数量再随便用。

verdict.en: A knockback mine for creating space, with a minor payoff against players who can step around it.
verdict.zh: 用于制造空间的击退地雷，对能绕开的玩家收益有限。

use.en: It knocks everyone in a wide radius backward and does no damage. Near ledges, ziplines or stairs the push can drop or disorient people, and it throws off hitboxes for a moment. It can push you too if you stand close. One ranking calls its PvP impact minimal because players avoid or step out of it.
use.zh: 它把范围内所有人击退，不造成伤害。在高台、滑索或楼梯附近，击退可能让人摔落或失去方向，短暂扰乱判定。你站太近也会被推开。有排行称它的PvP影响很小，因为玩家会躲开。

obtain.en: Apollo sells it for 1410 (limit 3). Craft it at the Explosives Station level 1 from Crude Explosives and Wires. A Toxic Trail and Keeping an Eye Out reward it.
obtain.zh: 阿波罗售价1410（限购3个）。在爆炸物工作台1级用粗制炸药和导线制作。“有毒的踪迹”和“循目追踪”奖励。

tips.en: Recycling returns 6 Chemicals, a decent consolation if you never use it.
tips.zh: 回收可得6个化学品，不用也不算亏。

verdict.en: The go-to answer to flying ARC; poor against big ground machines and useless against players.
verdict.zh: 对付飞行ARC的首选；打大型地面机器不行，对玩家无效。

use.en: Throw it within 20 meters and it homes on the nearest ARC for 50 damage. Guides say one kills a Wasp, two a Hornet, and a stack handles Launch Tower waves. It can chew through a Leaper with about eight hits but a full stack will not finish a Bastion from full health, so use it as a finisher there. Better than a gun when you want to avoid exposing yourself to players.
use.zh: 在20米内扔出，会追踪最近的ARC造成50点伤害。攻略称一颗能解决“黄蜂”，两颗解决“马蜂”，一叠可以应付发射塔的波次。大约八颗能磨掉一只“跳跃者”，但一整叠也无法从满血打死“堡垒”，只适合补刀。想避免在玩家面前暴露时，比开枪更好。

obtain.en: Apollo sells it for 1920 (limit 6). Craft it at the Explosives Station level 1 from ARC Alloy and Crude Explosives. Boarding the Frigate, Shoring Up Defenses, Sparks Fly, Stable Housing, Test Case and Paving the Way reward it.
obtain.zh: 阿波罗售价1920（限购6个）。在爆炸物工作台1级用ARC合金和粗制炸药制作。“登上护卫者”、“加固海岸防线”、“灭蜂大计”、“稳固住宅”、“测试案例”和“开辟道路”奖励。

tips.en: Apollo caps purchases at 6 a day, so crafting is the way to build a stockpile.
tips.zh: 阿波罗每天限购6个，想囤货要靠自己制作。

tips.en: Keep a stack for Launch Tower events.
tips.zh: 留一叠应对发射塔事件。

verdict.en: A strong escape and crowd-control tool, mostly for ARC: the 7-second ARC stun is worth far more than the 2 seconds you get on players.
verdict.zh: 逃生和控场利器，主要对付ARC：对ARC眩晕7秒，对玩家只有2秒。

use.en: Throw it at a group of pushing ARC, or at your own feet when a big machine closes in, to freeze them while you reload, revive a teammate or walk to extraction. Against raiders the short stun only buys a moment to swap weapons or finish a downed player. It also goes off on direct impact, so it works in a pinch.
use.zh: 对着正在逼近的ARC群投掷，或在大型机器贴脸时扔向脚边，趁它们被定住时换弹、救队友或走向撤离点。对玩家只有短暂眩晕，只够你换枪或补倒地的人。直接命中目标也会立刻引爆，危急时可用。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Explosives Station once you have the blueprint (Voltage Converters are the awkward part). The grenade drops from explosive-type loot such as military storage and Raider camp grenade lockers, and quests hand out several copies.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在爆炸物工作台制作，变电器是比较难凑的材料。手雷本体多出自军事仓储和袭击者营地的手雷柜等爆炸物类容器，任务也会送出不少。

tips.en: Quests such as Tracks of the Beast and The Clean Dream already give you several, so don't craft until those are spent.
tips.zh: “巨兽踪迹”“净梦计划”等任务就会送你好几枚，用完再考虑制作。

tips.en: Recycling returns two of the three recipe parts, so a spare one is better recycled than sold at 2,100.
tips.zh: 分解能返还三种材料里的两种，多余的拿去分解比卖2100更划算。

verdict.en: A cheap early frag for unarmored targets and players; it falls behind heavier grenades once you fight armored ARC.
verdict.zh: 便宜的早期破片手雷，适合打玩家和无甲目标；遇到重甲ARC就吃力。

use.en: Use it to clear a doorway or flush a player out of a corner. Armor plating shrugs off the 60 damage, so don't count on it against bigger machines; players rate the Heavy Fuze Grenade above it for tougher targets.
use.zh: 用来清门口或把玩家逼出墙角。60点伤害打不穿装甲板，别指望它对付大型机器；玩家普遍认为更厉害的“重型引信手雷”更适合硬目标。

obtain.en: Cheap to craft from Crude Explosives and Steel Springs, and the first quests (A First Foothold, Safe Passage) give three each. Apollo also sells it, but the coin price is steep for what it does.
obtain.zh: 用粗制炸药和钢质弹簧制作成本低，“首个立足点”“安全通路”各送三枚。阿波罗也卖，但价格对其威力来说偏高。

tips.en: Craft it in raid if you have the parts rather than buying: Apollo's price is three times the sell value.
tips.zh: 有材料就在局内自己做，阿波罗的售价是出售价的三倍。

verdict.en: Worth keeping a few: a 20-second cloud saves revives, crossings and extractions, and it is made from common Chemicals.
verdict.zh: 值得常备几枚：20秒烟幕能保住救人、过空地和撤离，材料只是常见的化学品。

use.en: Drop it between you and a sniper, on a downed teammate before a revive, or over the extraction point. It blocks sight for both ARC and raiders. Combine it with a Tagging Grenade to see enemies inside the smoke while they cannot see you.
use.zh: 扔在你和狙击手之间、救倒地队友之前，或撤离点上方。它同时遮挡ARC和玩家的视线。配合标记手雷，可以看到烟里的敌人而对方看不到你。

obtain.en: The blueprint comes from residential containers, so loot homes rather than industrial spots. Once learned, 14 Chemicals and a Canister make one; otherwise Apollo sells a few each day.
obtain.zh: 蓝图出自居民类容器，所以应搜居住区而非工业区。学会后用14份化学品和一个小罐即可制作，也可以向阿波罗购买，每天有限量。

tips.en: The cheaper Li'l Smoke Grenade covers short dashes; save the big one for revives and extraction.
tips.zh: 便宜的小型烟雾手雷适合短距离冲刺，大烟雾手雷留给救人和撤离。

verdict.en: A niche trap: fine as an automatic escape screen at a choke point, but a thrown smoke is faster and more reliable.
verdict.zh: 偏冷门的陷阱：放在要道自动放烟还行，但直接扔烟雾手雷更快更稳。

use.en: Stretch the laser across your retreat path or a doorway so it blankets the area when someone crosses. The beam is red and visible, so hide it behind cover or corners. An untriggered trap can be disarmed and picked up, so it costs nothing to reposition.
use.zh: 把激光拉在撤退路线或门口，有人经过时自动放烟。红色光束肉眼可见，要藏在掩体或拐角后。未触发的陷阱可以拆除回收，换位置不会亏。

obtain.en: Craft it from a Smoke Grenade and Wires, in raid or at the Workbench, after learning the blueprint. The quest Battening Down gives three.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后，用一枚烟雾手雷加导线制作，局内或工作台均可。“加固防御”任务送三枚。

tips.en: It uses up a whole Smoke Grenade, so only build one when you will actually be setting up a position.
tips.zh: 它会消耗一整枚烟雾手雷，真要守点时再做。

verdict.en: Craft a stack of these: a sticky 70-damage bomb that works on players and flying ARC.
verdict.zh: 值得做一叠：粘性的70点伤害炸弹，对玩家和飞行ARC都管用。

use.en: It sticks where it lands, so throw it at a rushing opponent or into a doorway and it is hard to dodge. Against flying ARC it is a go-to: a Wasp dies to one, while a Rocketeer takes a few.
use.zh: 落地即粘，扔向冲来的对手或门口很难躲。对付飞行ARC尤其好用：黄蜂一枚就死，火箭手要几枚。

obtain.en: Craft it from Crude Explosives and a Magnet; the Magnet is the limiting part. A First Foothold, Safe Passage and Sparks Fly all pay out copies, and Apollo stocks three a day.
obtain.zh: 用粗制炸药和磁铁制作，磁铁是瓶颈。“首个立足点”“安全通路”“灭蜂大计”都会给，阿波罗每天供应三枚。

tips.en: Sparks Fly asks you to hand some in, so don't recycle early copies.
tips.zh: “灭蜂大计”需要上交，前期别分解。

tips.en: Recycling returns only one Magnet and one Chemicals, so keep them for throwing.
tips.zh: 回收只得 1 个磁铁和 1 份化学品，留着当手雷用更划算。

verdict.en: A joke item: harmless, worthless and gone when the raid ends, only useful for Cold Snap trials.
verdict.zh: 纯娱乐道具：几乎没伤害、不值钱，离局即消，只有寒潮的试炼用得上。

obtain.en: Only on Cold Snap variants of Dam Battlegrounds, Buried City, The Spaceport and The Blue Gate. Pick up from snow piles on the surface; none on Stella Montis. Unspent snowballs turn to water in the stash.
obtain.zh: 只出现在寒潮版的大坝战场、掩埋废城、太空港和蓝门地表，从雪堆中拾取。星辰山没有。没用掉的雪球回到藏身处会化成水。

tips.en: Weekly trials like throwing snowballs at Rocketeers or Bastions are the only real reason to collect them.
tips.zh: 每周试炼里要求向火箭手或堡垒扔雪球，这才是收集它们的实际理由。

tips.en: Staying outside in the cold builds frostbite, so grab them and move on.
tips.zh: 在室外久待会积累冻伤，捡了就走。

verdict.en: A situational decoy and zone-denial gadget; interesting for holding a spot, too expensive to bring casually.
verdict.zh: 偏场合的诱饵和区域封锁装置，适合守点，不适合随便带。

use.en: Place it where you plan to hold or loot. It zaps everything within 10 metres every couple of seconds and ARC redirect their aggression toward it like a lure. Its small health pool means it wears out, so treat it as a temporary shield for a fight or revive.
use.zh: 放在你要守或要搜刮的地方。它每隔几秒电击10米内一切，ARC会像被诱饵吸引一样转而攻击它。血量不高会被磨掉，当作战斗或救人时的临时屏障。

obtain.en: Apollo sells it for a lot of coins, or craft it at Explosives Station 3 after learning the blueprint. The First Nomads and Safe Harbor reward copies.
obtain.zh: 阿波罗有售但很贵，也可学会蓝图后在爆炸物工作台3级制作。“初代游民”和“安全港湾”会送。

tips.en: Do not buy it from Apollo: his price is three times its sell value, and quests already supply a few.
tips.zh: 别向阿波罗买：售价是出售价的三倍，任务本来就会送几个。

verdict.en: An information tool for players hiding in buildings or smoke; skip it if you mostly fight ARC.
verdict.zh: 情报道具，用来揪藏在建筑或烟里的玩家；主要打ARC就别带。

use.en: Throw it into a room or smoke cloud to reveal everyone inside for about 30 seconds. Players describe pairing it with a Smoke Grenade as the best use. Some say the tag lasts shorter than the tooltip claims.
use.zh: 扔进房间或烟幕，大约30秒内显示里面所有人。玩家认为配烟雾手雷最好用，也有人说实际标记时间比说明短。

obtain.en: Craft at the Utility Station level 3 from Electrical Components and Sensors. The League gives five, and Clamoring for Attention and Eyes in the Sky three each.
obtain.zh: 在工具工作台3级用电子元件和传感器制作。“球队”送五枚，“哗众取宠”“天空之眼”各送三枚。

tips.en: Quest rewards cover most needs, so there is little reason to build many.
tips.zh: 任务奖励基本够用，没必要大量制作。

verdict.en: Cheap and flexible: the best ambush grenade when you control the timing, and a PvE tool for sticking to ARC.
verdict.zh: 便宜又灵活：你掌握引爆时机时是最好的伏击手雷，也能粘在ARC身上。

use.en: Throw it onto a surface, ARC or player and detonate it with the aim button when targets are in range. It never explodes on its own. Use at extraction points and chokepoints. A nerf in early 2026 lengthened the delay, so mid-air detonation is harder.
use.zh: 扔到墙面、ARC或玩家身上，目标进入范围后用瞄准键引爆，它不会自己爆炸。适合撤离点和要道。早先的削弱拉长了延迟，半空引爆更难。

obtain.en: Finish the Sparks Fly quest for the blueprint, then craft at the Explosives Station with Crude Explosives and a Processor. Loot drops are inconsistent.
obtain.zh: 完成“灭蜂大计”任务拿蓝图，之后用粗制炸药和处理器在爆炸物工作台制作。掉落不稳定。

tips.en: Switch away and back later and you can still detonate it.
tips.zh: 切换到别的物品再切回来，仍能引爆。

verdict.en: The best anti-ARC grenade for big targets, but it is pricey and unreliable against players.
verdict.zh: 对付大型ARC最好的手雷，但造价高，对玩家不太行。

use.en: Throw it when several ARC are visible so the 12 homing missiles split across targets. Players rate it for Rocketeers, flyers, Bastions and Bombardiers; bosses with many hitboxes use the spread less efficiently. Missiles hunt ARC, not raiders.
use.zh: 在多个ARC同时可见时投掷，12枚追踪导弹会分散命中。玩家推荐用来打火箭手、飞行单位、堡垒和投弹手；多部位的首领会让弹幕效率变低。导弹追踪ARC，不针对玩家。

obtain.en: Craft at Explosives Station 3 with ARC Motion Cores and a Rocketeer Driver; those parts are the expense. Bait, Fetch, Blast, Out of the Shadows and Tracks of the Beast reward some.
obtain.zh: 在爆炸物工作台3级制作，需要ARC运动核心和“火箭手”引擎，开销主要在这里。“诱饵、搜寻、爆破”“走出阴影”“巨兽踪迹”有奖励。

tips.en: It does not stack, so one slot per grenade; carry few.
tips.zh: 不能堆叠，一枚占一格，少带。

tips.en: Trophy Display needs five, so hold off recycling.
tips.zh: “战利品展示”项目需要五枚，别急着分解。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 utility grenade with little community data yet; try it before spending parts.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增的功能手雷，社区资料还很少，先试用再投入材料。

use.en: It anchors a line to whatever it hits and pulls the target toward the point of impact for a second. The wiki page is still a stub, so exact matchups are unconfirmed.
use.zh: 它会把绳索固定在命中物上，把目标拉向落点约1秒。维基页面仍是草稿，具体对阵效果尚未证实。

obtain.en: Craft at Explosives Station 2 with Crude Explosives and Rope after learning the blueprint. Salvaging returns Fabric.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在爆炸物工作台2级用粗制炸药和绳子制作。拆解可得布料。

tips.en: Avoid third-party sites selling the blueprint.
tips.zh: 不要从第三方网站购买蓝图。

verdict.en: Worth owning the blueprint for: a 1,000-damage mine that can erase a Bastion or Bombardier in one blast.
verdict.zh: 值得入手蓝图：1000点伤害的地雷，一发就能炸掉堡垒或投弹手。

use.en: Arm it next to a big ARC or inside a room you will bait enemies into. You cannot disarm or detonate it early; it blows after 6 seconds, hits several parts of large machines at once, and is lethal to raiders without cover. Run before it goes.
use.zh: 贴在大型ARC旁，或布置在你要引敌进入的房间里。放下后无法拆除或提前引爆，6秒后爆炸，大型机器的多个部位同时受伤，没掩体的玩家会被秒。记得及时撤开。

obtain.en: Blueprints come from Raider Caches, weapon boxes, medical bags and grenade tubes; reports mention the Control Tower on Dam Battlegrounds and Town Hall in Buried City. The Clean Dream gives two.
obtain.zh: 蓝图出自袭击者储物箱、武器箱、医疗包和榴弹筒；有人提到大坝战场控制塔和掩埋废城市政厅。“净梦计划”送两枚。

tips.en: Craft rather than buy; Apollo's daily stock of one is very expensive.
tips.zh: 自己制作，别买；阿波罗每天只有一枚，价格很高。

tips.en: Do not recycle it: the return is only half the materials.
tips.zh: 别分解，只能拿回一部分材料。

verdict.en: A reusable shield for revives and holding a corner; cheap, and anyone can pull it down in five seconds.
verdict.zh: 可重复使用的掩体，适合救人和守拐角；便宜，但谁都能5秒拆掉。

use.en: Deploy it between you and incoming fire while reviving, reloading or healing. Dismantle and pick it up to redeploy at full health. Laser traps work on it, while mines placed on it fall to the ground without triggering.
use.zh: 在救人、换弹、治疗时架在你和火力之间。拆下后可回收，满血重新部署。激光陷阱能放在上面，地雷会掉到地面且不触发。

obtain.en: Craft it with one Mechanical Component at the Utility Station after learning the blueprint, or buy up to six a day from Apollo. Safe Passage, Reduced to Rubble and Shoring Up Defenses give three each.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后用一个机械元件在工具工作台制作，或每天向阿波罗买最多六个。“安全通路”“化为废墟”“加固海岸防线”各送三个。

tips.en: If you leave it behind, the next raider can use it too, so take it with you.
tips.zh: 留下的话别人也能用，走时带走。

verdict.en: A cheap single-use lock for button-operated doors, mainly worth carrying for the quests that ask for them.
verdict.zh: 便宜的一次性锁，用于按钮门；主要是任务需要才值得带。

use.en: Stick it on a door you have just passed through, to slow pursuers or protect a room while you loot. It cannot be recovered, only breached.
use.zh: 贴在你刚通过的门上，拖延追兵或在搜刮时守住房间。无法回收，只能破门。

obtain.en: Cheap to craft from Metal Parts and Rubber Parts at the Utility Station. Reduced to Rubble, A Prime Specimen and Dormant Barons each give three.
obtain.zh: 在工具工作台用金属零件和橡胶零件就能做。“化为废墟”“完美样本”“休眠的男爵”各送三个。

tips.en: Apollo's price is three times its sell value; craft or use quest copies.
tips.zh: 阿波罗卖的价格是出售价三倍，自己做或用任务奖励。

verdict.en: A cheap early-warning alarm; fine for sleeping spots, but quests ask for it more than combat does.
verdict.zh: 便宜的预警警报；适合守着休息，更多是任务在要它。

use.en: Attach it near a door or stairwell you are looting; it sounds an alarm when raiders enter its 8 metre radius, so you can fight on your terms.
use.zh: 装在你搜刮时附近的门口或楼梯口；玩家进入8米范围就会响铃，让你先手。

obtain.en: Craft it in raid from Plastic Parts and a Speaker Component. Many early quests take it: Clamoring for Attention and On Deaf Ears want five each.
obtain.zh: 可在局内用塑料零件和扬声器零件制作。很多前期任务要它：“哗众取宠”“充耳不闻”各要五个。

tips.en: Do not buy at Apollo's price; the recipe is two cheap parts.
tips.zh: 别按阿波罗的价格买，配方只要两种便宜材料。

verdict.en: A niche fire trap for corridors and large ground ARC like Leapers, not a general-purpose grenade.
verdict.zh: 小众的火焰陷阱，适合走廊和“跳跃者”这类大型地面ARC，不是万能手雷。

use.en: Throw it so the gas trail lies where enemies must cross, then it ignites in a chain. Trial guides say Leapers are the best target. Players also throw it into a room and shut the door on a Shredder. Stack several for a Bastion.
use.zh: 让气体拖尾铺在敌人必经之路，随后连锁点燃。试炼攻略认为“跳跃者”最合适。也有人把它扔进房间再关门对付“粉碎者”。打“堡垒”要叠几枚。

obtain.en: Craft at Explosives Station 3 with a Firefly Burner and Synthesized Fuel. Deciphering The Data and Fragmented Logs give three each.
obtain.zh: 在爆炸物工作台3级用“萤火虫”燃烧炉和合成燃料制作。“解密数据”“碎片日志”各送三枚。

tips.en: Quest copies cover testing; skip building spares unless a trial needs it.
tips.zh: 任务奖励够试用，除非试炼需要，别特意做备用。

verdict.en: A social toy with zero combat value; hold it only for the Trophy Display project or to jam with friends.
verdict.zh: 纯社交道具，没有战斗价值，只为“战利品展示架”项目或和朋友合奏留着。

use.en: It plays one of seven melodies, and nearby Raiders can join in with a Recorder or Shaker. While you play, many two-handed actions are blocked, so only strum when the area is quiet and you are not about to loot or climb.
use.zh: 能演奏七段旋律之一，附近的奇袭者可以用可演奏长笛或摇铃加入合奏。演奏时许多双手操作会被禁用，只适合在安静时弹，别在要搜刮或攀爬前用。

obtain.en: Shani no longer sells it after 2.0, and no quest rewards it. The reliable routes are completing the Trophy Display project and the Goalie Raider Deck (AR/RD 002). Recycling returns Metal Parts and Wires, far below its 7000 sale value, so keep or sell it rather than break it down.
obtain.zh: 2.0 后萨尼不再出售，也没有任务奖励。稳妥的来源是完成“战利品展示架”项目，或奇袭者套件 AR/RD 002。回收只得金属零件和导线，远低于 7000 的售价，别拆。

tips.en: At 7000 it is one of the most valuable Quick Use items to sell, but it takes a quick use slot and stacks to 1.
tips.zh: 售价 7000，是最值钱的快速使用物品之一，但堆叠上限为 1，还占快速使用栏。

verdict.en: Cheap stamina refill that is good for kiting and escapes, but never a replacement for healing.
verdict.zh: 便宜的体力回复针，适合风筝和脱身，但不能代替治疗。

use.en: It fully refills stamina in one second and then boosts regeneration for 10 seconds. Use it when you are out of stamina mid-chase or mid-climb, not as a health item. Players ranking post-Riven Tides items rate it as a cheap raid saver, but not top tier.
use.zh: 1 秒内回满体力，之后 10 秒内体力恢复加快。适合追逐或攀爬中体力耗尽时用，不回血。玩家对裂潮镇更新后物品的排名里它算便宜的救场道具，但不是顶级。

obtain.en: Lance sells it for 900, three times its 300 value. Crafting costs six materials but recycling returns only two, so crafting is poor value. Seven quests, including Espresso and Doctor's Orders, hand you three each, which covers most needs.
obtain.zh: 兰斯卖 900，是价值 300 的三倍。制作要六份材料而回收只返还两份，不划算。“浓缩咖啡”“医生的订单”等七个任务各送三支，基本够用。

tips.en: Do not buy it from Lance; take the quest copies and craft only if you have spare Chemicals.
tips.zh: 别向兰斯买，用任务送的就好，化学品有富余再制作。

verdict.en: A sidegrade to the Basic Camera that only photography fans need; skip it for your quick use slots.
verdict.zh: 是简易相机的升级款，只有爱拍照的玩家需要，快速使用栏不必给它。

use.en: The wiki says it does everything the Basic Camera does and more, but community pages have not documented the extras yet. For quests that ask for photos, the Basic Camera already works.
use.zh: 社区维基称它能完成简易相机的一切并有额外功能，但目前还没有页面写明具体差别。需要拍照的任务用简易相机就够了。

obtain.en: Shani sells up to 3 at 3000 each, and it also appears in the free Reward Pass. You can craft it at Utility Station level 1 once you learn the blueprint, from a Calculator, Camera Lens and Electrical Components.
obtain.zh: 萨尼出售，限购 3 个，每个 3000；免费奖励通行证也有。学会蓝图后可在工具工作台 1 级用计算器、相机镜头和电子元件制作。

tips.en: Recycling gives back a Calculator, so a spare is not a total loss.
tips.zh: 回收可得到计算器，多出来的也不算白费。

verdict.en: A cheap in-raid stamina drink; it sells for more than bandages, but the health cost makes it a niche pick.
verdict.zh: 局内可造的廉价体力饮料，卖价比绷带高，但要扣血，属于小众选择。

use.en: It boosts stamina regeneration for 10 seconds at a cost of 5 health. Drink it before a sprint or long fight when you are healthy; do not use it at low health. The Adrenaline Shot does the same job without hurting you and also refills stamina instantly.
use.zh: 10 秒内加快体力恢复，代价是扣 5 点生命。在血量健康、要冲刺或长时间交战前饮用，残血别喝。肾上腺素针剂不扣血，还能立即回满体力，效果更好。

obtain.en: Craft it in a raid from Agave and an Empty Wine Bottle. Players report Agave around Riven Tides dunes and the northwest of Dam Battlegrounds; bottles show up in homes and kitchens. Salvaging the juice returns the bottle.
obtain.zh: 在局内用龙舌兰叶和空酒瓶制作。玩家反馈龙舌兰叶多见于裂潮镇沙丘和大坝战场西北，空酒瓶常在民居和厨房。拆解成品能拿回酒瓶。

tips.en: Its 1800 sale value is high for two cheap inputs, so it is also a small money-maker if you already carry the ingredients.
tips.zh: 两份便宜材料就值 1800，顺手带着材料的话也算小赚。

verdict.en: The default early heal: craft it from Fabric and never buy it from Lance.
verdict.zh: 前期的默认治疗品：用布料自己做，别向兰斯买。

use.en: It heals 2 per second for 10 seconds, about 20 health, after a 1.5 second use. That is slow, so apply it after you break line of sight. The Herbal Bandage heals faster but is costlier to buy.
use.zh: 使用 1.5 秒后 10 秒内每秒回 2 点，共约 20 点。回血慢，先脱离视线再用。草药绷带回得更快，但购买更贵。

obtain.en: Five Fabric at a Workbench or Medical Lab, or in the raid with in-round crafting. Lance asks 750, three times its 250 value. Recycling returns only 2 Fabric.
obtain.zh: 用五份布料在工作台或医疗实验室制作，学会局内制作后也能在局内做。兰斯卖 750，是价值 250 的三倍。回收只返还 2 份布料。

tips.en: Keep a stack of five in your quick use bar and carry spare Fabric to craft more mid-raid.
tips.zh: 快速使用栏放满五个，另带些布料以便局内补做。

verdict.en: A novelty instrument with no combat use; keep it only if you want to play music in raids.
verdict.zh: 纯娱乐乐器，没有战斗用途，想在局内弹奏再留着。

use.en: Like the other instruments, it attracts ARC attention and impresses other Raiders, and blocks many two-handed actions while you play. Do not play it when enemies are near.
use.zh: 和其他乐器一样，会吸引 ARC 注意，也能让其他奇袭者眼前一亮，弹奏时许多双手操作会被禁用。附近有敌人时别弹。

obtain.en: New in 2.0. The community wiki lists no spawn source, and I found no map location for it. A French report says its blueprint comes with the Collector DLC set. You can craft it at a Workbench level 1 after learning the blueprint, from Plastic Parts and Steel Cable.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增。社区维基没有列出来源，也没找到地图位置；有法语报道称蓝图随收藏家 DLC 套装附送。学会蓝图后可在工作台 1 级用塑料零件和钢缆制作。

tips.en: Its 1000 sale value beats its crafting cost, but check that blueprint availability first.
tips.zh: 它 1000 的售价高于制作成本，但先确认你有没有蓝图。

verdict.en: Needed for photo quests and then dead weight; carry one only when a quest asks for it.
verdict.zh: 只有拍照任务才需要，完成后就是累赘，要做任务时再带。

use.en: Equip it in a quick use slot, aim and shoot. Sizing Things Up asks you to photograph fixed subjects, and several other quests give you a camera. It is lost if you die with it, so a spare is cheap insurance.
use.zh: 放入快速使用栏，瞄准后拍摄。“审时度势”要求拍摄固定目标，另有多个任务会送你相机。带着死亡会丢失，所以备一个便宜的当保险。

obtain.en: Shani sells up to 3 daily for 1920. Eight quests, such as Sizing Things Up, hand you one, so buying is rarely needed. Crafting costs 8 Plastic Parts and a Wires at Workbench level 1.
obtain.zh: 萨尼每天限购 3 个，每个 1920。“审时度势”等八个任务会送一个，所以很少需要买。工作台 1 级用 8 塑料零件和 1 导线即可制作。

tips.en: Recycling returns Plastic Parts, but crafting it is cheap, so only sell it if you have no photo quest left.
tips.zh: 回收只得塑料零件，而制作成本很低，没有拍照任务了再卖掉。

verdict.en: A scouting tool for careful players; worth a slot only if you have spare quick use space.
verdict.zh: 给谨慎玩家侦察用的工具，快速使用栏有空位才值得带。

use.en: It gives two zoom levels, and you can ping enemies or items while scoped. Use it to check open ground and POIs before committing. It gives information only, so a Zipline or Barricade Kit beats it when slots are tight.
use.zh: 有两档放大，开镜时可标记敌人或物品。适合在推进前观察空地和兴趣点。它只提供情报，栏位紧张时不如滑索或路障工具。

obtain.en: Craft it at Utility Station level 1 from Plastic and Rubber Parts, no blueprint needed. Six quests, like Combat Recon, give you one, and the Ryder and Voyager Raider Deck holds 3. Shani sells it for 1920.
obtain.zh: 在工具工作台 1 级用塑料零件和橡胶零件制作，无需蓝图。“战斗侦察”等六个任务会送一个，奇袭者套件 AR/RD 001里有 3 个。萨尼卖 1920。

tips.en: It has durability, so repair it with Plastic and Rubber Parts instead of buying a new one.
tips.zh: 它有耐久，用塑料零件和橡胶零件修理，比重买划算。

verdict.en: Cheap throwable lights; keep a handful for quests and skip them in your quick use bar.
verdict.zh: 廉价投掷照明，留几根交任务，不必占快速使用栏。

use.en: Each lights a 7m radius for 40 seconds. That helps in dark interiors and for marking a spot, but it also shows others where you threw it. Red and yellow versions work the same.
use.zh: 每根照亮半径 7 米，持续 40 秒。适合照亮黑暗室内或做标记，但也会暴露你的位置。红色、黄色版本效果相同。

obtain.en: Quests give them: A Warm Place To Rest, After Rain Comes and The Clean Dream five each of Blue, In My Image five Green. Shani sells for 3000, but Apollo's 450 offer was listed by the community wiki. Both need the blueprint and 3 Chemicals at a Utility Station.
obtain.zh: 任务会送：“温暖的休憩之地”“风雨过后”“净梦计划”各 5 根蓝色，“与我同形”5 根绿色。萨尼标价 3000，社区维基另提到阿波罗 450。在工具工作台制作需要蓝图和 3 化学品。

tips.en: Crafting spends 3 Chemicals but recycling returns 1, so use quest copies and do not craft extras.
tips.zh: 制作花 3 化学品，回收只返还 1，用任务送的，别额外制作。

verdict.en: A niche but real escape tool for big drops; craft a few when you need one.
verdict.zh: 高处跳落时很实用的小众保命道具；需要时做几个备着。

use.en: Throw it at the ground before you jump, then land on it to avoid fall damage up to 10m. The mat is small and lasts about 10 seconds, so a bad throw or drift misses it. A teammate cannot reuse your mat.
use.zh: 先把它扔到地上再跳，落在垫上可避免 10 米内的摔伤。垫子不大且持续约 10 秒，投偏或下落时漂移就会落空。队友不能共用同一块垫子。

obtain.en: Wires Crossed gives you 2. Craft it from Durable Cloth and Electrical Components after learning the blueprint, at Utility Station level 2 or in the raid. Sources differ on where the blueprint drops, so treat any specific spot as unverified.
obtain.zh: “线路交错”送 2 个。学会蓝图后，用耐磨布料和电子元件在工具工作台 2 级或局内制作。蓝图掉落位置各来源说法不一，具体地点不要尽信。

tips.en: No live project needs it, so keep only what you will throw; recycling returns 6 Fabric and 3 Plastic Parts.
tips.zh: 目前没有进行中的项目要它，只留自己要扔的；回收可得 6 布料和 3 塑料零件。

verdict.en: A strong squad insurance item; carry one or two when you play with friends.
verdict.zh: 组队时的强力保险，和朋友一起玩带一两支。

use.en: It revives a downed Raider, in your party or not, and restores health faster than a normal revive. It only works on downed players, not fully dead ones. Reviving a random player for 3000 coins is rarely worth it, but it can win you an ally.
use.zh: 能救起倒地的奇袭者，无论是否在你队里，且回血比普通救援多。只对倒地者有效，对已死亡者无效。花 3000 钱币救陌生人通常不划算，但有时能换来盟友。

obtain.en: Lance sells it for 3000. Nine quests such as Medical Merchandise and Armored Transports reward it, and the Raider Decks hold 3 each. Crafting needs the blueprint, Medical Lab level 2, 9 Plastic Parts and 1 Moss.
obtain.zh: 兰斯卖 3000。“医疗物资”“装甲运输”等九个任务会奖励，奇袭者套件里各有 3 支。制作需要蓝图、医疗实验室 2 级、9 塑料零件和 1 苔藓。

tips.en: Do not recycle it: you get only 1 Moss and 1 Plastic Part back from a 1000 value item.
tips.zh: 别回收，一件价值 1000 的物品只返还 1 苔藓和 1 塑料零件。

verdict.en: Only useful on Riven Tides when Beachcombing is active; skip it on every other run.
verdict.zh: 仅在裂潮镇“海滩拾荒点”条件开启时有用，其他对局别带。

use.en: It reveals caches buried in the sand: beeps speed up as you near one. You walk slowly while it runs, and a shared energy meter means carrying several does not extend runtime. Digging can turn up ARC Ticks and mines, so check surroundings first.
use.zh: 能找出埋在沙里的物资，越近蜂鸣越快。使用时只能慢走，所有探测器共用一条能量，多带无用。挖掘可能挖出 ARC 蜱虫或地雷，先看四周。

obtain.en: Apollo sells up to 2 at 1920, and Shoring Up Defenses rewards one. Community guides also name shipping containers, but that is unconfirmed here. It cannot be recycled.
obtain.zh: 阿波罗限购 2 个，每个 1920；“加固海岸防线”送一个。社区攻略还提到货柜，这里未能确认。无法回收。

tips.en: Keep it for the Mountaineer's Detector ingredient, and bring Batteries to repair it.
tips.zh: 它是“登山者探测器”的材料，别随手卖，另带电池以便修理。

verdict.en: Use it on the spot at Pendola Pass: it is the key to the Emperor's coupler loot.
verdict.zh: 在彭多拉山口当场使用：它是拿“帝王”耦合器战利品的钥匙。

use.en: Place it in an open area to call in Harvester Payloads. Debris starts falling soon after, so move away at once. One main payload holds the three Couplers and the Emperor Gateway Conduit blueprint; the smaller containers never hold Couplers.
use.zh: 在空旷处放置，召来“收割者”空投。碎片很快落下，立刻跑开。其中一个主空投里有三种耦合器和“帝王”通道导管蓝图，小型容器不会出耦合器。

obtain.en: Interact with a damaged Emperor relay during the Redirection condition on Pendola Pass, or pick up a fallen beacon. You can carry 3, but it cannot be kept between raids.
obtain.zh: 在彭多拉山口“航向重定向”期间与受损的“帝王”中继站互动，或拾取倒落的信标。最多带 3 个，不能带到下一局。

tips.en: Couplers and the blueprint are random, so expect several payloads; store each Coupler in your stash.
tips.zh: 耦合器和蓝图都是随机的，需要多开几次空投，拿到的耦合器放进仓库。

verdict.en: A balanced food that heals and refills stamina, good for forage-minded players, but not an emergency heal.
verdict.zh: 兼顾回血和体力的食物，适合爱采集的玩家，但不适合紧急治疗。

use.en: It restores 25 health and 50 stamina in one 2 second action. It is a decent top-up between fights, but the Bandage and Herbal Bandage heal more over time.
use.zh: 一次 2 秒的使用回 25 点生命和 50 点体力。适合战斗间隙补充，但治疗量不如绷带和草药绷带。

obtain.en: Only by in-raid crafting from an Apricot, Lemon and Prickly Pear. No source for the fruit locations was found, so I cannot give spots. It cannot be recycled.
obtain.zh: 只能局内用杏子、柠檬和仙人掌果制作。没找到水果的具体分布资料，这里不写地点。无法回收。

tips.en: It sells for 1800, so selling it is better than crafting it if you only need Fruit for money.
tips.zh: 售价 1800，如果只是为了赚钱，做出来卖也可以。

verdict.en: A 2.0 mobility gadget worth a slot on vertical maps if you already have the blueprint.
verdict.zh: 2.0 新增的机动道具，有蓝图的话在多垂直落差的地图值得带。

use.en: It anchors to most surfaces at up to 20m, for reaching ledges and shortcuts. Community coverage is thin; the wiki page is a stub. It also weighs 5, far more than most gadgets, and wears down, so pack it only when your route needs it.
use.zh: 最远 20 米可钩住大多数表面，用来上高处和抄近路。社区资料很少，维基页面还是草稿。它重量为 5，比大多数道具重，还会磨损，路线需要时再带。

obtain.en: Quests give one each: Boarding the Frigate, Tracks of the Beast, Belly of the Beast, Ruins and Reverberations and Empathetic Prototypes. After learning the blueprint, craft from a Cable Stripper, Mechanical Components and 2 Rope in the raid or at Utility Station 1.
obtain.zh: 任务各送一个：“登上护卫者”“巨兽踪迹”“兽腹深处”“废墟和回响”“共情原型机”。学会蓝图后可在局内或工具工作台 1 级用剥线钳、机械元件和 2 绳子制作。

tips.en: Repair costs a Cable Stripper and Rope, so do not mistake it for the older Snap Hook.
tips.zh: 修理要剥线钳和绳子，别和旧的安全钩搞混。

verdict.en: A pocket novelty instrument; fun, but sell it unless you want to play.
verdict.zh: 随身的娱乐乐器，好玩但没用，不想吹就卖掉。

use.en: It attracts ARC attention and impresses other Raiders, and many two-handed actions are blocked while you play. Light at 0.2 weight, it is the easiest instrument to carry.
use.zh: 会吸引 ARC 注意，也能让其他奇袭者眼前一亮，演奏时许多双手操作被禁用。重量只有 0.2，是最好带的乐器。

obtain.en: New in 2.0; the wiki lists it as a scavenged item, with Residential as the only location. Recycling returns 4 Metal Parts, while its sale value is 1000, so selling is the better deal.
obtain.zh: 2.0 新增；维基记录为搜刮获得，地点只写了住宅区。回收得 4 金属零件，而售价为 1000，卖掉更划算。

tips.en: It is a stub on the community wiki, so details may change.
tips.zh: 社区维基页面还是草稿，细节可能变动。

verdict.en: Heals about 75% faster than a Bandage and is worth carrying, but buying it from Lance is pricey.
verdict.zh: 回血比绷带快约 75%，值得携带，但向兰斯购买偏贵。

use.en: It heals 3.5 per second for 10 seconds, about 35 health, with the same 1.5 second use. Players favor it as the main heal for mid-gear runs. The Bandage heals around 20 for much less.
use.zh: 每秒回 3.5 点，持续 10 秒，约 35 点，使用时间同样是 1.5 秒。玩家常把它当中期装备的主力治疗。绷带约 20 点但便宜得多。

obtain.en: Craft it with Durable Cloth and Great Mullein at the Medical Lab or in the raid. Lance sells up to 10 for 2700, and the Ryder and Voyager Raider Deck holds 5. Recycling returns Assorted Seeds and Fabric.
obtain.zh: 在医疗实验室或局内用耐磨布料和大毛蕊花制作。兰斯每天限购 10 个，每个 2700；奇袭者套件 AR/RD 001里有 5 个。回收可得混合种子和布料。

tips.en: Per coin the Bandage is about twice as efficient, so buy neither: craft the Herbal Bandage.
tips.zh: 按钱币计算绷带效率约为两倍，所以都别买，自己做草药绷带。

verdict.en: A niche digger for Pendola Pass snow and Riven Tides sand: fun for treasure hunts, a poor use of a slot on a normal loot run.
verdict.zh: 彭多拉山口雪地和裂潮镇沙滩的挖宝专用，普通搜刮不值得占快捷栏。

use.en: It finds objects buried in snow or sand: beeps speed up as you close in, and you walk slowly while it runs. Switching on costs a chunk of its energy meter, so one long sweep beats several short ones. The meter refills while it is off, and carrying extra detectors does not add energy.
use.zh: 它能探测埋在雪地或沙地里的物体：越靠近，提示音越急促，使用时只能慢走。开启瞬间会消耗一截能量，所以连续探一次比多次短开更划算。关闭后能量会回复，多带几个也不会增加能量。

obtain.en: Craft it at the Workbench once you have learned the blueprint; the recipe eats a Dockmaster's Detector, so you are upgrading one rather than starting from scratch. The community wiki lists scavenging only and no quest source.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工作台制作，配方要消耗一个码头主管探测器，相当于升级旧探测器。社区维基只列出搜刮来源，没有任务奖励。

tips.en: Only worth bringing on Pendola Pass or Riven Tides runs where you plan to dig; elsewhere it does nothing.
tips.zh: 只有计划去彭多拉山口或裂潮镇挖宝时才带，其他地图完全没用。

tips.en: Buried spots can hold traps such as mines or ARC Ticks, so slow down once the beeping turns frantic.
tips.zh: 埋藏点可能有地雷或ARC跳蚤之类的陷阱，提示音急促时要放慢脚步。

verdict.en: Cheap insurance against ARC: it breaks line of sight even mid-fight, but you only walk and it does nothing against players.
verdict.zh: 对付ARC的保险：连交战中的ARC也会丢失目标，但只能走路，且对玩家无效。

use.en: While active, ARC lose track of you, which makes it good for sneaking past a Bastion, crossing a patrolled room or breaking off a bad fight. Your speed drops to a slow walk, and the energy meter is shared between cloaks, so extra copies do not extend the cloak. Players have also paired it with Deadline Mines to take down big ARC unnoticed. Patch 1.29 halved its power drain.
use.zh: 开启后ARC会丢失你的踪迹，适合绕过“堡垒”、穿过有巡逻的房间或从不利战斗中脱身。使用时只能慢走，多个斗篷共用同一条能量，多带也不会更久。玩家还会配合“死线”地雷无声清掉大型ARC。1.29补丁把耗电减半了。

obtain.en: Craft at Utility Station level 3 (it is not a blueprint item). The Mixed Signals quest hands one out, and the community wiki says the Trophy Display project asks for 3 of them, so hold some back.
obtain.zh: 在工具工作台3级制作，无需蓝图。任务“混合信号”会送一个；社区维基提到“战利品展示”项目需要3个，别全卖掉。

tips.en: Repair is cheaper than a new craft, and recycling gives back half the parts, so repair a worn cloak instead of scrapping it.
tips.zh: 修理比重做便宜，回收只返还一部分材料，磨损的斗篷优先修理。

tips.en: Do not rely on it against other Raiders: it only hides you from ARC.
tips.zh: 别指望它躲玩家，它只对ARC有效。

verdict.en: A genuine traversal tool for rooftops and tall drops, but it needs wind-up time, so use it early and treat it as a luxury slot.
verdict.zh: 屋顶和高处下落的实用位移工具，但需要起转时间，要提前开，属于奢侈型快捷栏。

use.en: Turn it on before you jump, not mid-fall; it slows your descent and gives a short lift, and it shuts off when its power runs out. Players use it to reach high loot (rooftops, ledges, skylight rooms) and to drop out of sight when a PvP fight goes badly. It is not dependable from the very tallest towers.
use.zh: 要在起跳前就开启，而不是下落途中；它能减缓下落并带来短暂上升，能量耗尽就会关闭。玩家用它够到屋顶、壁架、天窗房间里的物资，也用来在PvP不利时借高度脱离视线。从最高的塔上跳下仍不可靠。

obtain.en: Craft at Utility Station level 3 after learning the blueprint, which drops randomly; guides suggest checking Hotel Panorama Azzurro in Riven Tides. The Disrupting the Frigate quest also gives one.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工具工作台3级制作，蓝图随机掉落，有攻略建议去裂潮镇的蔚蓝全景酒店碰运气。任务“干扰护卫者”也会送一个。

tips.en: It weighs 5 and wears out, so the repair parts (ARC Circuitry) add up if you use it every raid.
tips.zh: 它重量为5且会磨损，每局都用的话ARC线圈的修理开销会累积。

tips.en: If your only goal is surviving falls, a cheaper fall-softening item does the job.
tips.zh: 如果只想摔不死，更便宜的缓降道具就够了。

verdict.en: A fun social toy, not a tool: playing it draws ARC, so skip it unless you are in a safe spot or with friends.
verdict.zh: 社交玩具而非工具：吹奏会引来ARC，除非在安全处或和朋友一起，否则别带。

use.en: It plays one of two melodies. Nearby Raiders can listen or join in with a Shaker or Acoustic Guitar for a group jam. You cannot do many two-handed actions while playing, and the noise attracts ARC, so use it near extraction or in a cleared building.
use.zh: 可以演奏两段旋律，附近的奇袭者可以驻足欣赏，或用摇铃、原声吉他加入合奏。演奏时很多双手动作无法使用，声音还会招来ARC，适合在撤离点附近或已清空的建筑里用。

obtain.en: Buy from Apollo (limit 6 a day); the community wiki says Shani stopped selling it in 2.0. It also turns up as loot in Residential areas.
obtain.zh: 可向阿波罗购买（每日限购6个）；社区维基称2.0之后萨尼不再出售。居民区也能搜到。

tips.en: Recycling gives 10 Plastic Parts, which is worth far less than the 3000 coins Apollo charges, so never buy one for materials.
tips.zh: 回收只给10个塑料零件，远不及阿波罗3000钱币的售价，别为材料去买。

verdict.en: A novelty instrument you can craft in a raid; it attracts ARC, so only shake it somewhere safe.
verdict.zh: 可在局内制作的趣味乐器，会招来ARC，只在安全的地方摇。

use.en: It plays one of two rhythms and pairs with the Recorder and Acoustic Guitar for group jams. Two-handed actions are blocked while you play, and the sound draws ARC.
use.zh: 能摇出两种节奏，可与可演奏长笛、原声吉他合奏。演奏时无法做双手动作，声音还会引来ARC。

obtain.en: Craft it in-raid from Assorted Seeds and a Canister; loot in Residential areas also works. On Deaf Ears hands one out, and the community wiki says traders no longer sell it.
obtain.zh: 可在局内用混合种子和小罐制作，也能在居民区搜到。任务“充耳不闻”会送一个；社区维基称商人已不再出售。

tips.en: Source accounts disagree on spawn spots (random loot versus a Buried City easter egg), so do not plan a route around one.
tips.zh: 关于刷新点说法不一（随机搜刮或掩埋废城彩蛋），别专门为它规划路线。

verdict.en: Cheap throwable lights for dark interiors, plus quest fodder; carry a few for darkness, never for fights.
verdict.zh: 便宜的投掷照明，用于黑暗室内和任务材料；照明时带几根，不是战斗工具。

use.en: Throw one to light a 7 m circle for 40 seconds. It helps in unlit buildings, tunnels and night raids, and marks a spot for teammates. Red and yellow behave identically, so colour is just a signalling choice.
use.zh: 投出后照亮7米范围，持续40秒，适合无灯建筑、隧道和夜间局，也能给队友标记位置。红色和黄色效果相同，颜色只是用来区分信号。

obtain.en: Craft with 3 Chemicals at Utility Station level 1 after learning the blueprint, or buy from Shani. Several quests reward stacks of 5 (The League, What Goes Around, Eyes in the Sky, Bees!, Movie Night).
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工具工作台1级用3份化学品制作，也可向萨尼购买。多个任务会送5根一组（球队、因果报应、天空之眼、蜜蜂！、电影之夜）。

tips.en: Recycling returns only one Chemical for three spent, so use them rather than scrap them.
tips.zh: 回收只返还1份化学品，而制作要3份，用掉它们别拆。

verdict.en: A signalling toy and quest item: cheap to make, rarely worth a slot in a normal loadout.
verdict.zh: 信号玩具兼任务道具：做起来便宜，但普通配装里很少值得占一格。

use.en: Place it, then trigger it by hand to fire a Raider Distress Flare, the same flare shown when a Raider goes down. It can mark a rally point or an extraction spot.
use.zh: 先放置，再手动触发，会打出与倒地求救相同的雷达求救信号弹。可用来标记集合点或撤离点，也能伪装成有人倒地。

obtain.en: Craft at Utility Station level 1 with the blueprint, or buy from Apollo. Off The Radar, The Trifecta and A Prime Specimen each give some, so the quests may already cover you.
obtain.zh: 拥有蓝图后在工具工作台1级制作，也可向阿波罗购买。“销声匿迹”“三连胜”“完美样本”都会送，任务可能已经替你备好。

tips.en: Draws attention to your position, so trigger it from a spot you can leave.
tips.zh: 信号弹会暴露位置，触发后要能立刻离开。

verdict.en: The budget shield refill: slow, but it fills a Light Shield and can be made in the field.
verdict.zh: 经济型护盾补充：慢，但能充满轻型护盾，还能在局内制作。

use.en: It gives 4 shield per second for 10 seconds, so use it once you are out of the fight rather than mid-fire. It restores shield only, never health. For a faster top-up in combat, the Surge Shield Recharger delivers 50 at once.
use.zh: 每秒恢复4点护盾，共10秒，所以要在脱离交火后使用，而不是交火中。它只补护盾，不补生命。想在战斗中快速补盾，爆能护盾充能器能一次给50点。

obtain.en: Craft in-raid, at a Workbench, or at the Medical Lab, using an ARC Powercell and Rubber Parts. Lance sells it too, and Clean Hands, Belly of the Beast and Someone Else's Shoes give some.
obtain.zh: 可在局内、工作台或医疗实验室用ARC能量电池和橡胶零件制作；兰斯也出售，任务“清理指针”“兽腹深处”“换核思考”也会送。

tips.en: The ARC Powercell is the bottleneck, so only craft as many as you will use.
tips.zh: ARC能量电池是瓶颈，按用量制作，别囤太多。

tips.en: Recycling gives just 4 Rubber Parts, so sell or use spares.
tips.zh: 回收只给4份橡胶零件，多余的直接用掉或卖掉。

verdict.en: Worth a slot if you run a shield: 50 shield in one go beats the basic recharger, but costs a 5 second window.
verdict.zh: 带护盾的话值得占一格：一次补50点，强于基础充能器，但要5秒读条。

use.en: Applied on use after a short 5-second animation, so duck behind cover first. It suits mid-fight resets between pushes better than the 10-second trickle of the basic version. Several quests (Waking the Grid, Out of the Shadows, On The Map) hand them out, so you get free stock early.
use.zh: 使用需约5秒读条，先找掩体。比基础版10秒的缓慢回复更适合在交火间隙重整。“唤醒安保网络”“走出阴影”“在地图上”等任务会送，早期库存不愁。

obtain.en: Craft at Medical Lab level 2 with an Advanced ARC Powercell and Electrical Components, or buy from Lance (limit 5 a day).
obtain.zh: 在医疗实验室2级用高级ARC能量电池和电子元件制作，或向兰斯购买（每日限购5个）。

tips.en: Advanced ARC Powercells are scarcer than basic ones; craft in batches only when you have a surplus.
tips.zh: 高级ARC能量电池比基础款稀缺，有富余再批量制作。

verdict.en: The premium mobility tool: great for verticality, flanks and climbing big ARC, but expensive to craft and repair.
verdict.zh: 高端位移工具：垂直机动、绕后和攀爬大型ARC都很强，但制作和修理都贵。

use.en: Chain short hooks between ledges and railings to climb faster than one big swing, and keep a charge for escapes since the bar refills slowly. Players also hook large ARC like the Queen or Matriarch to reach the shielded hull, and grab a wall mid-fall to stop short of the ground. A fall-clip using it went viral on Reddit.
use.zh: 在壁架和栏杆间短距离连续钩爬，比一次长摆更快；因为能量条回复慢，要留一格应急。玩家还会钩上“女王”“族母”等大型ARC去打顶部护甲，或下落中钩墙避免摔死。一段用它在空中击杀的视频曾在ç¤¾åº爆火。

obtain.en: Craft at Utility Station level 3 after learning the blueprint, or find one while scavenging. Boarding the Frigate, Belly of the Beast, Stable Housing and Lost in Transmission each give one, so quests can supply your first.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工具工作台3级制作，或搜刮获得。“登上护卫者”“兽腹深处”“稳固住宅”“迷失在传输中”都会送一个，首个可以靠任务拿到。

tips.en: Repair eats an Exodus Module, which is expensive, so do not spam it in routes that sprinting would clear.
tips.zh: 修理要耗离巢模块，开销不小，跑过去就行的路线别乱用。

tips.en: The community wiki reports the 2.0 patch cut its range and raised wear per use; check the in-game numbers.
tips.zh: 社区维基称2.0削弱了射程并提高了单次磨损，请以游戏内数值为准。

verdict.en: The reliable mid-tier heal: slow to finish, but quick to start and easy to stock, so it earns a quick-use slot early on.
verdict.zh: 可靠的中阶治疗：起效慢但上手快、好囤货，前期值得占一格。

use.en: It heals 5 per second for 10 seconds, so about 50 in total after only 1.5 seconds to start. Best once you are behind cover or moving away; it is poor as a panic button. Pair it with an instant heal like the Vita Shot.
use.zh: 每秒恢复5点，共10秒，约合50点，但只需1.5秒起手。适合躲进掩体或边撤边用，不适合当救急键。可搭配生命针剂这类瞬间治疗。

obtain.en: Craft at Medical Lab level 2 from Antiseptic and Durable Cloth, or buy from Lance (limit 3 a day). Many quests (Clearer Skies, Doctor's Orders, Home to Roost and others) give 2 to 3 at once.
obtain.zh: 在医疗实验室2级用防腐剂和耐磨布料制作，或向兰斯购买（每日限购3个）。“清朗天空”“医生的订单”“归巢”等任务一次送2到3个。

tips.en: Because quests hand out so many, check your stash before buying from Lance at 6000 coins.
tips.zh: 任务送得多，向兰斯花6000钱币购买前先看看仓库。

verdict.en: A new 2.0 gadget with niche utility: it can link two points at long range, but it is a squad or puzzle tool, not a general slot.
verdict.zh: 2.0新增的小众工具，能在远距离连接两点，是小队或解谜用，不是通用快捷栏。

use.en: Two shots anchor a line to whatever each hits, linking both points for 10 seconds at up to 30 m. Early guides suggest pairing it with a grappling hook to take high ground, and say it can tie a Raider to an ARC machine. Treat that as unverified, since the community wiki page is a stub.
use.zh: 两发各自将绳索固定在命中处，连接两点，持续10秒，最远30米。早期攻略建议与抓钩搭配抢高地，并称可以把雷达与ARC机器绑在一起，但社区维基页面只是草稿，这一点未经证实。

obtain.en: Craft at Utility Station level 2 once you have learned the blueprint. I found no confirmed drop location for the blueprint, so expect it from general containers and locked rooms.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在工具工作台2级制作。蓝图的掉落地点没有可靠来源，大概率出自普通容器和上锁房间。

tips.en: Few sources have tested it yet; try it on a quiet run before committing a slot.
tips.zh: 实测资料很少，先在安静的局里试试再决定占不占格。

verdict.en: The best burst heal in the early-to-mid game: bring one or two for the emergencies a bandage cannot cover.
verdict.zh: 前中期最好的爆发治疗：带一两支，应对绷带来不及的紧急情况。

use.en: Restores 50 health after a 4-second use, much quicker to deliver than the Sterilized Bandage. Guides recommend one instant heal plus one over-time heal in the same loadout. The 4 seconds is still long, so break line of sight first.
use.zh: 4秒读条后恢复50点生命，起效比消毒绷带快得多。攻略建议配装里带一个瞬间治疗加一个持续治疗。4秒仍然不短，先躲开视线。

obtain.en: Craft at Medical Lab level 3 with Antiseptic and a Syringe after learning the blueprint, or find in the field. Medical Merchandise, Waking the Grid and Empathetic Prototypes all give some.
obtain.zh: 学会蓝图后在医疗实验室3级用防腐剂和注射器制作，也可在局内找到。“医疗物资”“唤醒安保网络”“共情原型机”都会送。

tips.en: Recycling returns 4 Chemicals and a Syringe, so a spare is worth keeping rather than scrapping.
tips.zh: 回收可得4份化学品和1支注射器，富余的留着比拆掉划算。

verdict.en: The team medic's tool: the most healing per item and it works on allies, but it is bulky and costly to craft and repair.
verdict.zh: 队医专用：单件治疗量最大，还能给队友用，但体积大，制作和修理都贵。

use.en: Heals 10 per second, up to 150 total, so a full tank takes about 15 seconds of holding still. That is a lot for a solo player, but ideal when a squad regroups behind cover or someone needs reviving back to health. It wears out and must be repaired.
use.zh: 每秒恢复10点，总量150，用完约需15秒站定。单人用太奢侈，但小队在掩体后整备或帮队友回血时很理想。它会磨损，需要修理。

obtain.en: Craft at Medical Lab level 3, which needs a Tick Pod on top of Antiseptic and a Canister, so farm Ticks first. Eyes in the Sky and Disrupting the Frigate each give one, and the community wiki says the Trophy Display project needs 3.
obtain.zh: 在医疗实验室3级制作，除防腐剂和小罐外还要“跳蚤”收纳舱，得先去刷跳蚤。“天空之眼”和“干扰护卫者”各送一个；社区维基称“战利品展示”项目需要3个。

tips.en: Solo players are better off with a Vita Shot plus Sterilized Bandage.
tips.zh: 单人玩家带生命针剂加消毒绷带更合适。

verdict.en: A social prop with no combat value: skip the slot unless you like roleplaying a surrender.
verdict.zh: 没有战斗价值的社交道具：除非想演投降戏，否则别占格。

use.en: You plant it or wave it to signal a truce to other Raiders. It does nothing against ARC, and it only works if the other player chooses to respect it. Guides also note it costs a quick-use slot for no mechanical benefit.
use.zh: 放置或挥动，用来向其他雷达示意停战。对ARC无效，也只有对方愿意配合才有用。攻略也指出它占一个快捷栏却没有实际收益。

obtain.en: Craft in-raid or at the Medical Lab level 1 with the blueprint. The blueprint is a random Riven Tides drop, reportedly more likely in industrial areas like the Stacking Yard.
obtain.zh: 拥有蓝图后可在局内或医疗实验室1级制作。蓝图是裂潮镇的随机掉落，据称工业区（如堆场）机会更大。

tips.en: Recycling gives back half the Fabric, so extras are better recycled than carried.
tips.zh: 回收可返还一半布料，多余的拆掉比带着强。

verdict.en: A cheap, reliable mobility item that unlocks quest objectives, especially on Pendola Pass; worth a slot when you need height or speed.
verdict.zh: 便宜好用的位移道具，尤其在彭多拉山口能解锁任务目标；需要高度或速度时值得带。

use.en: Deploy two ends up to 60 m apart on most surfaces and ride between them. It is required for the Exploring Pendola Pass antenna on the Railyard tower, and a fast way onto the Cielo Sereno Observatory roof. You can place and reuse the line during a raid.
use.zh: 在最远60米的两点之间放置，几乎能挂在任何表面上并滑行。“探索彭多拉山口”中铁路调度场塔楼的天线必须用它，也是上西耶洛·塞雷诺天文台楼顶的快路。

obtain.en: Craft in-raid or at Utility Station level 2 from Mechanical Components and Steel Cable, or buy from Apollo (limit 2 a day). Many Pendola Pass quests hand out several, so you rarely need to buy.
obtain.zh: 可在局内或工具工作台2级用机械元件和钢缆制作，或向阿波罗购买（每日限购2个）。许多彭多拉山口任务会送好几个，基本不用买。

tips.en: Salvaging in raid gives 4 Metal Parts, so spare ones are worth a quick scrap.
tips.zh: 局内分解可得4份金属零件，富余的可以顺手拆。
